parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10,000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The user's department. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: FuzzyUsername
parameters.description: The username for a fuzzy match. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), asterisks (\*), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PreciseUsername
parameters.description: The username for an exact match. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), asterisks (\*), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the user. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: The user is enabled.

- **Disabled**: The user is disabled.
